scope: Frontend design foundation and active ingredient inventory screen
foundation: Espresso/paper semantic tokens, 6px controls, 8px panels, restrained elevation, operational density, 120/180ms CSS motion, reduced-motion override. Preserve current React/Tailwind architecture and public component props. Native dialog provides focus containment, Escape and focus restoration. No new dependencies.
behavior: Existing /admin/inventory redirect to /admin/ingredients retained. Ingredient search/lowStock parameters, stock/cost calculations, imports, waste, Agent scan and ADMIN/STAFF gates unchanged. Read failure gains persistent ErrorState and explicit GET retry. No backend, route, auth or schema edits. Existing mock provider remains opt-in.
